commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) for a tough tackle.
90+5' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.

90+3' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) displays brilliant individual ability, gets inside the box and pulls the trigger. His promising effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
90+2' Thomas Partey (Villarreal) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
90+2' Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.

89' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) releases a promising shot from the set piece towards the middle of the target, but Arnau Tenas makes a save to deny him.
86' Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.

84' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.

82' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

77' Here is a change. Willy Kambwala is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Logan Costa (Villarreal).
77' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
75' The attendance for today's match is 12836.

56' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
54' The game is interrupted now, Santiago Mourino (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
52' Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
49' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' 2 - 0 Goal! Oscar Trejo gets to the ball, slips Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Tajon Buchanan comes off for Alfonso Gonzalez (Villarreal).
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo De Burgos starts the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Arnau Tenas was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' Villarreal couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
41' The players claim that Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) handled the ball and it seems they are right.

40' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
38' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is able to continue to play.
34' Alberto Moleiro (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
33' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
31' Great teamplay by Rayo Vallecano as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
28' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) was set free in the area by Andrei Ratiu and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top left corner. 1:0.
27' Rayo Vallecano will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

22' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
20' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

19' A rebound lands at the feet of Sergi Cardona (Villarreal), whose promising strike from long range crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
18' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

18' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

14' The ball is cleared after Pape Gueye (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

6' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
5' Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
